observations: Earlier left lifting tilted the pot (9,10).
Right lift tests missed; subsequent contact displaced the pot (15,19–21).
The pot rotated during closure and repositioning (33).
Right forward targets repeatedly failed planning (34–36).
Partial closure near 11 cm was transient, not proof of capture (37,38).
The left wrist rose 4.78 cm while the pot remained on the table; the right lift failed planning (38).
Both grippers finished fully closed at 4.9 cm separation (38).
hypotheses: The right arm's current configuration may severely restrict reachable nearby targets.
astra_final_memory.summary: Attempt 1 failed to secure both handles. Pot remains on the table after the lift test (38). Do not interpret transient 11 cm separation during closure as a grasp: both fingers subsequently reached 4.9 cm. Right forward and upward motions repeatedly failed (34–36,38). A fresh attempt should establish accessible bilateral approach poses and verify completed closure before lifting.
